quiz_adaptations: Focus on foundational logic building exercises
Include more visual and interactive problem-solving tasks
Incorporate step-by-step guided examples for mathematical concepts
Use motivational reinforcement strategies like progress tracking and rewards

modules.title: Foundations of Computer Science
modules.description: This module introduces core computer science concepts, including what computers are, how they work, and their role in modern society.
objectives: Identify components of a computer system
Recognize the role of algorithms in programming

sub_modules.title: What is Computer Science?
sub_modules.description: An overview of computer science as a discipline, its history, and its applications.
learning_outcomes: Define key terms related to computer science
Explain the importance of abstraction and modeling
List common fields within computer science

activities.title: Interactive Timeline Exploration
activities.description: Explore an interactive timeline of major milestones in computer science history.
learning_objectives: Gain historical context for computing developments

activities.title: Video Lecture Series
activities.description: Watch short video lectures introducing fundamental concepts such as hardware vs software, data representation, and algorithmic thinking.

sub_modules.title: Introduction to Algorithms
sub_modules.description: Learn what algorithms are, why they're important, and how we represent them.
learning_outcomes: Define algorithm with real-world examples
Trace simple algorithms using flowcharts or pseudocode
Evaluate algorithm efficiency at a high level

activities.title: Algorithm Puzzles Workshop
activities.description: Solve everyday puzzles that mirror computational processes (e.g., sorting socks).
learning_objectives: Practice breaking down problems into steps
Develop intuitive understanding of sequencing and loops

activities.title: Pseudocode Writing Practice
activities.description: Translate simple daily routines into structured pseudocode format.
learning_objectives: Express logic clearly without code syntax

modules.title: Programming Fundamentals I
modules.description: Begin your journey into programming by learning variables, conditionals, and functions through hands-on practice.
objectives: Write and run basic programs using a chosen language
Create reusable blocks of code using functions
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with typing and file management

sub_modules.title: Variables and Data Types
sub_modules.description: Explore how data is stored and manipulated in memory using variables.
learning_outcomes: Declare and initialize variables correctly
Understand different types of data (strings, numbers)
Perform basic operations on variables

activities.title: Variable Playground Lab
activities.description: Use an online coding environment to experiment with creating and manipulating variables.

activities.title: Data Type Identification Challenge
activities.description: Complete a series of mini-quizzes identifying correct data types for given scenarios.
learning_objectives: Recognize appropriate use cases for each type

sub_modules.title: Conditionals and Control Flow
sub_modules.description: Control program execution using if-else structures and boolean logic.
learning_outcomes: Implement decision-making logic in code
Use comparison and logical operators accurately
Debug branching issues systematically

activities.title: Conditional Maze Game
activities.description: Navigate a virtual maze by writing conditional logic that responds to user input.
prerequisites: Completion of Variables and Data Types

activities.title: Boolean Logic Truth Table Builder
activities.description: Construct truth tables manually before implementing equivalent logic in code.
learning_objectives: Bridge abstract logic with practical implementation
assessment_criteria: Correspondence between table and code behavior

modules.title: Problem Solving & Logical Reasoning
modules.description: Build strong analytical thinking skills essential for effective programming and debugging.
objectives: Break complex problems into manageable parts

sub_modules.title: Breaking Down Problems
sub_modules.description: Learn techniques for decomposing large tasks into smaller solvable pieces.
learning_outcomes: Identify subproblems within larger challenges
Plan solutions using decomposition methods
Communicate breakdown strategy clearly

activities.title: Real-Life Scenario Mapping
activities.description: Map out routine activities like making breakfast into discrete steps similar to program instructions.
learning_objectives: Translate real-world actions into sequential logic
Identify potential failure points in sequences

activities.title: Debugging Detective Stories
activities.description: Read fictional debugging narratives where learners must identify root causes based on symptoms.

sub_modules.title: Pattern Recognition Exercises
sub_modules.description: Engage with exercises designed to enhance ability to spot recurring themes and structures.
learning_outcomes: Detect similarities across diverse problems
Generalize solution patterns appropriately
Transfer learned approaches to new contexts

activities.title: Visual Pattern Matching Games
activities.description: Play games involving shape/color sequences to train cognitive flexibility and analogy formation.
assessment_criteria: Reflection journal entries about observed patterns

activities.title: Code Snippet Pattern Hunt
activities.description: Review sample code snippets to find repeated structural elements or design motifs.

modules.title: Mathematical Thinking for Programmers
modules.description: Strengthen mathematical foundations relevant to computation, especially logic and number theory.
objectives: Understand logic gates and Boolean algebra
Grasp fundamentals of counting and probability
Apply mathematical tools confidently in coding contexts

sub_modules.title: Logic Gates and Boolean Algebra
sub_modules.description: Study digital circuits and symbolic representations used in both hardware and software.
learning_outcomes: Represent logical expressions visually and symbolically
Simulate gate behaviors using truth tables
Convert word problems into Boolean equations

activities.title: Digital Circuit Simulator Lab
activities.description: Manipulate virtual logic gates to build functional circuits responding to specific inputs.
learning_objectives: Reinforce connection between math and electronics
assessment_criteria: Circuit simulation outputs match expected results
Ability to explain circuit function verbally

activities.title: Boolean Equation Translator
activities.description: Translate English sentences into formal Boolean notation and vice versa.
learning_objectives: Master translation between natural and formal languages
Improve clarity when expressing logic precisely

sub_modules.title: Numbers and Counting Principles
sub_modules.description: Dive into numeric representations, conversions, and combinatorics useful in computing.
learning_outcomes: Convert between decimal, binary, and hexadecimal formats
Count possibilities using permutations and combinations
Estimate resource requirements via approximation

activities.title: Base Conversion Calculator Project
activities.description: Build a small tool that converts numbers among various bases interactively.
learning_objectives: Deepen conceptual grasp of numeral systems
Gain hands-on experience applying conversion rules

activities.title: Probability Dice Rolling Simulations
activities.description: Run simulations rolling dice thousands of times to understand statistical distributions intuitively.
learning_objectives: Connect experimental outcomes to theoretical probabilities
assessment_criteria: Graphical representation of distribution matches theory
